subject: MedAtlas: PO format, multi-entity invoicing & milestone billing options
messages:
From: Rajesh Kumar <r.kumar@medatlas.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medatlas.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO fields + invoicing cadence for enterprise purchase

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and the routing controls. Procurement here needs to lock down a few billing/PO constraints before we can route the purchase to Legal and Finance. High level asks: please confirm whether Redwood can support the following for an enterprise purchase across three legal entities: 

1) Per-entity invoices (each invoice must include: PO number, bill-to legal entity name, tax id/EIN, cost center). We may also ask for a consolidated month-end statement for internal reconciliation.
2) Net terms: default request is Net45, but Finance asked whether Net30 is feasible with a purchase order; otherwise they will ask for Net45 and staged milestone invoices.
3) Invoice cadence: we are considering milestone invoicing aligned to project activation (50% on onboarding milestone, monthly usage thereafter) — what is Redwood's preferred way to model that with your packaging?
4) Discounting: our Sourcing team needs to know whether a single cross-entity annual commitment will qualify for a consolidated volume discount, or whether discounts need to be allocated by entity.

Attaching our standard PO template for reference (MedAtlas_PO_template.pdf). Can you loop in billing/finance to confirm fields and give a rough timeline for approvals?

Best,
Rajesh
Rajesh Kumar
Senior Procurement Manager, MedAtlas Health
Attachment: MedAtlas_PO_template.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Kumar <r.kumar@medatlas.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medatlas.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoicing cadence for enterprise purchase

Hi Rajesh — thanks for the clear summary and the PO template. Looping in Vanessa (billing lead) and Vivek (enterprise sales) to confirm specifics. High-level answers below; Vanessa can add the precise field-level requirements.

Quick responses:
- Per-entity invoices: yes, we can emit invoices per legal entity and also provide a consolidated month-end statement for reconciliation.
- Net terms: standard hosted contracts are Net30; Net45 is possible as a commercial exception for enterprise deals but requires Finance approval.
- Milestone invoicing: we support milestone schedules and can set up an onboarding invoice + subsequent monthly usage invoices.
- Discounts: discounts are tied to the legal entity that signs the commitment by default, but we can structure a cross-entity agreement (master commitment + entity-level POs) to allocate a consolidated volume discount.

Vanessa — could you confirm the exact PO fields your team requires and whether the billing system can accept the MedAtlas template as-is? Also flag any data/attachments we should return to MedAtlas for audit (tax forms, W-9 equivalents).

Rajesh/Alyssa — can you share the expected timing for Legal and whether you have a preferred milestone schedule (e.g., 50/50 onboarding vs run-rate, or other)?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0198
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Rajesh Kumar <r.kumar@medatlas.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoicing cadence for enterprise purchase

Hi all — thanks for the details, Rajesh. I ran the MedAtlas template against our billing system and added a short spreadsheet with the exact field mappings (redwood-billing-specs.xlsx). Summary of what we need from the PO to process invoices without delay: 

Required PO fields:
- PO number (alphanumeric)
- Bill-to legal entity full name (must match W-9/Tax ID)
- Ship-to / Service address (for some of our tax/region rules)
- Tax ID / EIN for each entity
- Cost center or internal GL code (optional but preferred)
- Contact name + email for invoice questions

Notes on packaging and discounting: 
- Pricing blocks: we can price as a consumption-based volume commitment or a seat-based subscription. For a cross-entity single commitment, the commercial team can propose a consolidated discount applied at the master agreement level and then allocates credits to each entity invoice.
- Discount thresholds: typical bands are 10% @ 12-month committed baseline, 15% for multi-year and higher committed spend. We can confirm exact bands once we see the expected run rate across entities.

Net terms & milestone options: 
- Standard: Net30 for hosted customers.
- Commercial exception: Net45 possible for enterprise procurement after Finance signs off. That process typically takes 5–7 business days post-legal countersign.
- Milestone invoicing: we can create an onboarding invoice (one-time) and then monthly usage invoices. If MedAtlas needs milestone percentages (e.g., 50/50), we can encode that into the SOW and invoice schedule.

I've attached the mapping (redwood-billing-specs.xlsx). Rajesh — if you can send the entity matrix (mapping of entity names, EINs, and cost centers) we will draft a sample invoice set for review.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-billing-specs.xlsx
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medatlas.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <r.kumar@medatlas.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 12:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoicing cadence for enterprise purchase

Thanks Vanessa — attaching our entity matrix (MedAtlas_entity_matrix.xlsx) which lists the three legal entities, their EINs and primary cost centers. A few clarifications from Finance: 

- Preferred net terms are Net30 if possible. If Net30 is not approved, they will accept Net45 but will require milestone invoices for the onboarding split.
- For discounts: we want to make sure the consolidated discount (if approved) is reflected as a single line credit that reduces each entity invoice pro rata. Is that something Redwood can show on the invoice?
- Sample invoice layout would be helpful to get pre-approval from our AR team — could you send a sample per-entity and the consolidated month-end statement?

We are hoping to complete procurement by next week to hit an onboarding target in January.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Financial Operations, MedAtlas Health
Attachment: MedAtlas_entity_matrix.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Kumar <r.kumar@medatlas.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medatlas.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoicing cadence for enterprise purchase

Rajesh/Alyssa — appreciate the quick turnaround. Two commercial points and next steps: 

1) Discount structure: we can do a consolidated annual commitment and apply a master-level discount that shows as pro-rated credit on each entity invoice. Vanessa will produce a sample invoice set (per-entity + consolidated statement) by EOD.

2) Net terms compromise: Finance prefers Net30 as standard; given internal timelines we can pursue Net30 conditional on a short approval form (Finance waiver) or provide Net45 as the default while we fast-track the waiver. If MedAtlas can accept a 2% early-pay discount for payments within 20 days, we can prioritize Net30 approval.

Action items: 
- Vanessa: draft sample invoices and the consolidated statement (based on the attached matrix).
- Tessa: I will open a commercial exception ticket for Net30 with Finance and reference DEAL-8347.
- Rajesh/Alyssa: confirm whether the milestone schedule should be 50/50 onboarding/run-rate or something else so we can model the first invoices.

Also adding links for the contracting flow and DocuSign once the SOW is ready: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8347 and https://www.docusign.com/link/example-12345

We should be able to get this procurement path completed within 3 business days if MedAtlas confirms milestone split and returns the signed PO matrix.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
